title: Field Agent
summary: Get hands-on with yard work out in the field, providing mowing, trimming, edging, and other lawn care services directly to SeedBank customers.
responsibilities: Find and connect with potential new customers while out in the field
Provide satisfying yard work services, including mowing, trimming, and more
Respond to jobs and complete work in a timely manner
Follow proper safety procedures on every job
requiredQualifications: Must be at least 16 years old
preferredQualifications: Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with lawn care equipment
benefits: Free gas while on the job
whyJoinUs: To make your world better, one yard at a time. It's easy to apply, and SeedBank has a higher chance of getting you hired fast.

title: Cook / Dishwasher
summary: We are looking for a dedicated and skilled cook to join us in preparing great food for our customers. The ideal candidate is passionate about food preparation and has some knowledge and experience in cooking.
responsibilities: Follow food safety guidelines to maintain a clean kitchen environment
Ensure all food is prepared according to recipes and meets our taste standards
Maintain proper food handling techniques to prevent contamination
Work with other kitchen staff to meet demand during peak hours
Clean and sanitize work areas, utensils, and equipment after each use
requiredQualifications: Previous experience as a cook is preferred
Proficient knife skills and ability to safely use kitchen equipment
Strong organizational skills and the ability to multitask effectively in a fast-paced environment
Knowledge of food safety regulations and practices for food handling
Willingness to work in a team setting

title: Mobile Dog Groomer
summary: Bubbles & Barks is hiring its tenth groomer to complete staffing for five mobile grooming vans. The groomer will travel to scheduled appointments and provide friendly, careful dog washing and grooming services. Each operating van has two workers for safety, combining hands-on pet care, customer service, and daily upkeep of the mobile workspace.
responsibilities: Bathe, dry, brush, trim coats, and trim nails according to customer requests and each dog's needs
Work with a second groomer to handle dogs safely; complete company-provided aggressive-dog handling training and follow safe handling procedures
Confirm service requests with owners, record grooming preferences, and report concerns or unsafe situations to the Sales Manager
Clean and sanitize tools and the van between appointments; restock supplies and check water levels and equipment
Drive the company van as assigned, follow the appointment route, and communicate delays or maintenance needs promptly
requiredQualifications: Pet-friendly, patient, and committed to gentle, safe animal care
Able to safely lift up to 50 pounds, with assistance or reasonable accommodation as needed
preferredQualifications: One to two years of dog grooming experience
benefits: $12 per hour plus 5% commission and tips
Flexible hours, including scheduled evening and weekend appointments
Quarterly raises based on performance and opportunities for growth within the company
whyJoinUs: Join a pet-friendly team that brings convenient grooming directly to dog owners. Work alongside a partner in a mobile setting, build your grooming skills through training, and grow with Bubbles & Barks as we complete staffing for our five-van fleet.
